income_start_date.meaning: date lifetime withdrawals started; empty before

lifetime_withdrawal_pct.meaning: locked lifetime withdrawal percentage; empty before lifetime withdrawals start

annual_lifetime_withdrawal_amount.meaning: annual lifetime withdrawal amount; empty before lifetime withdrawals start

lifetime_withdrawal_frequency.meaning: frequency of lifetime withdrawals; none before they start

replacement_sale.meaning: whether the contract replaced another annuity or life policy

exchange_source_company.meaning: company funds were exchanged or transferred from, as on the transfer form; empty for new money

rmd_year.meaning: calendar year of the posted required minimum distribution; empty when none

rmd_amount_current_year.meaning: required minimum distribution posted for rmd_year; empty when none

spousal_continuation_date.meaning: date a surviving spouse continued the contract; empty otherwise

termination_date.meaning: date the contract ended; empty while it continues

indexed_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the fixed indexed annuity ledger row

customer_id.meaning: the owner at the time of the row (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the indexed charter

transaction_date.meaning: date the occurrence was recorded or took effect

amount.meaning: delta booked on the family's account, or the amount of a documentary row; always positive

source_txn_id.meaning: the premium row a bonus is credited on; empty otherwise

strategy.meaning: crediting strategy of an index credit

segment_start_date.meaning: start of a crediting period or segment

segment_end_date.meaning: end of a crediting period or segment

index_change_pct.meaning: S&P 500 point-to-point change over the segment, negative when the index fell

withdrawal_type.meaning: classification of a withdrawal: free_partial within the free amount, excess_partial with a charged part, rmd under the minimum distribution waiver, waiver_partial under an approved waiver, lifetime_covered within the annual lifetime withdrawal amount, lifetime_excess above it

free_portion_amount.meaning: part of a withdrawal free of charge and recapture

contract_year.meaning: contract year a charge, fee or roll-up belongs to

vesting_pct.meaning: vested share of the premium bonus applied in a recapture

payment_due_date.meaning: scheduled date of a guaranteed lifetime payment

indexed_request_id.meaning: the service request or claim behind the row (foreign key -> indexed_service_requests); empty when none

taxable_amount.meaning: taxable part of a distribution; 0.00 when none

net_paid_amount.meaning: amount actually paid after charges and withholding

payee_name.meaning: payee as named in the governing designation or court papers

beneficiary_name.meaning: beneficiary as written by the owner

designation_effective_date.meaning: date the owner signed the designation the line belongs to

indexed_request_id.meaning: primary id of the service request or claim

customer_id.meaning: the owner or claimant (foreign key -> customers)

received_date.meaning: date Ashgrove received the request in good order

signed_date.meaning: date the owner or claimant signed

decision_date.meaning: date approved, declined or completed; empty while open

requested_amount.meaning: amount requested; empty when not applicable

withholding_election.meaning: federal withholding election on a taxable distribution

requested_fixed_pct.meaning: fixed account share requested on a reallocation

requested_cap_pct.meaning: cap strategy share requested on a reallocation

requested_participation_pct.meaning: participation strategy share requested on a reallocation

income_joint_election.meaning: whether joint lifetime income was requested; lifetime income elections only

income_option_requested.meaning: income option on an annuitization election

confinement_start_date.meaning: first day of nursing facility confinement; waiver claims only

life_expectancy_months.meaning: certified life expectancy; terminal illness claims only

owner_date_of_death.meaning: owner's date of death; death claims only

death_certificate_received.meaning: whether a certified death certificate is on file; death claims only

claimant_name.meaning: beneficiary filing a claim as signed

claimant_relationship.meaning: claimant's relationship to the deceased owner

settlement_option.meaning: how a beneficiary elected to take a share

disbursement_method.meaning: how the requester asked to be paid

ltc_policy_id.meaning: primary id of the CareAssure policy record

policy_number.meaning: policy number printed on the contract

variant_name.meaning: the CareAssure tier, as the official full tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state (basis defined in the ltc charter lifecycle)

insured_is_owner.meaning: whether the owner is the insured

issue_date.meaning: policy date; policy years and anniversaries count from it

policy_delivery_date.meaning: date the owner received the policy; empty before placement

issue_age.meaning: insured's age last birthday on the issue date

specified_amount.meaning: specified amount of life and acceleration coverage

monthly_max_benefit.meaning: current monthly maximum long-term care benefit, including inflation increases

modal_premium.meaning: the single premium, or the ten-pay installment for the current mode

eft_draft_day.meaning: monthly EFT draft day; empty unless monthly_eft

paid_to_date.meaning: date through which ten-pay premiums are paid; empty for single premium

premium_outstanding.meaning: billed premium not yet paid or waived (integral of the premium_outstanding account)

ltc_benefit_pool_balance.meaning: acceleration benefits still available (integral of the ltc_benefit_pool account)

benefit_eligibility_date.meaning: first day of certified chronic illness on the current or most recent claim; empty if never claimed

elimination_satisfied_date.meaning: day the lifetime elimination period was satisfied; empty until satisfied

last_certification_date.meaning: date of the most recent practitioner certification of chronic illness

third_party_designee_name.meaning: person who receives lapse notices, as named by the owner; empty when designation was waived in writing

lapse_date.meaning: first day without coverage after lapse; empty unless lapsed or on shortened benefit

reinstatement_date.meaning: date of the most recent reinstatement; empty if none

termination_date.meaning: date the policy ended; empty while coverage continues

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the ltc charter

amount.meaning: delta booked on the family's account, or the amount of a documentary row; always positive

premium_due_date.meaning: installment the row bills, pays or waives

ltc_request_id.meaning: the service request or claim behind the row (foreign key -> ltc_service_requests); empty when none

service_month.meaning: first day of the calendar month of care a benefit row pays for

care_setting.meaning: setting of the care a benefit pays for

expenses_submitted.meaning: qualified expenses submitted for the month and setting

benefit_pct_applied.meaning: share of the monthly maximum applied for the setting

anniversary_date.meaning: policy anniversary of an inflation increase

rop_vesting_pct.meaning: return of premium share applied on surrender

beneficiary_name.meaning: beneficiary as written by the owner

designation_effective_date.meaning: date the owner signed the designation the line belongs to

customer_id.meaning: the owner or claimant (foreign key -> customers)

signed_date.meaning: date the owner or claimant signed

decision_date.meaning: date approved, declined or completed; empty while open

chronic_illness_basis.meaning: basis of the chronic illness certification

adl_count_certified.meaning: number of activities of daily living certified as lost

certification_date.meaning: date of the licensed health care practitioner's certification

plan_of_care_received.meaning: whether a plan of care is on file

lapse_cause_impairment.meaning: whether a practitioner certified that cognitive impairment or loss of functional capacity existed before the lapse; reinstatement requests only

insured_date_of_death.meaning: date of death; death claims only

cause_of_death.meaning: manner of death; death claims only

death_certificate_received.meaning: whether a certified death certificate is on file; death claims only
